generation.explanation: A Riemann sum approximates the area under a curve by adding up the areas of many thin rectangles. For y = x² from 0 to 2 we partition [0, 2] into n equal-width strips and take the height of each rectangle from a sample point (here the right endpoint). As n grows the stepped shape hugs the parabola more tightly and the total area approaches the exact integral ∫₀² x² dx = 8/3.
